twoWayTalk.haConnectionFailed: Home Assistant WebRTC could not establish two-way talk. Verify that the camera stream has a working audio backchannel.

notifications.pipUnsupported: Picture-in-Picture is not supported for this video.
notifications.pipStartFailed: Picture-in-Picture could not start in this browser.

toggle.unavailableDimmable: {name}: Unavailable. Turn on. Press and hold to adjust brightness
toggle.onDimmable: {name}: {percent}%. Turn off. Press and hold to adjust brightness
toggle.offDimmable: {name}: Off. Turn on. Press and hold to adjust brightness

linkedLight.powerOn: Turn on {name} at its previous brightness

wideView.resizeCompanionHint: Drag up or down to resize the Companion Cameras area

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.collapseHint: Drag to resize or click to collapse Timeline
timeline.nextStackEvent: Show next event in this stack
timeline.stackedEvents: {count} events stacked — use the mouse wheel or stack button to browse
timeline.empty: No alerts or events in this window

ptz.presetsNote: Camera Presets - presets are set on the camera.

live.resizeHint: Drag to resize live view; double-click or double-tap to reset

popup.resizeHint: Drag to resize popup media; double-click or double-tap to reset
popup.clipFallbackDetail: Showing the event snapshot. Frigate reported a clip for this event, but playback could not be loaded.
popup.snapshotUnavailableDetail: The requested snapshot could not be loaded from Frigate.
popup.mediaUnavailableDetail: Frigate reported media for this event, but neither the clip nor snapshot could be loaded.
popup.retentionDetail: Media may be missing, may have changed, or may have been removed according to the retention policy configured for this camera. Review the camera's recording retention settings in Frigate.

segment.guidance: Drag the handles to choose what to keep. Green is downloaded; red is excluded.
segment.previewPlayerUnavailable: Unable to create the segment preview player.
segment.previewUnavailable: Unable to load the selected recording segment.

browse.noRecordings: No recordings in the last 24 hours
browse.favoriteHint: star an event to add it to Favorites

status.unsavedChanges: Unsaved changes — use Home Assistant's Save button to apply them.

general.homeAssistantBelowRecommended: Home Assistant {version} is below the recommended {recommended}.
general.frigateNotInstalled: Frigate integration is not installed in Home Assistant.
general.cameraTokenHelp: Use {camera} to show the active camera name. Grid mode shows {grid}.
general.prePostRollHelp: Adds {seconds} seconds before and after alert and clip playback or downloads. Requires Frigate recordings.
general.favoritesAllCamerasHelp: Shows favorites from all configured cameras. Turn off to show only the active camera.
general.fallbackUpdateCheckHelp: Fallback interval for checking new alerts and reviews. Shorter intervals use more battery and data.
general.snapshotRefreshHelp: How often snapshots refresh when Live View is off.
general.alertLiveDurationHelp: How long an alerted Preview or Wide View snapshot switches to live.

theme.applyLightMode: Apply custom theme in light mode
theme.applyDarkMode: Apply custom theme in dark mode
theme.applyBothModes: Apply custom theme in both modes
theme.draftChangesRequireSave: Draft changes require card config save.

layout.autoHeightHelp: Card needs to be set to Auto Height for this to work properly.
layout.cardHeightRangeValidation: Select a whole number from {min} to {max}.
layout.tightMarginsHelp: Removes padding in Sections views. In Bubble Card popups, keeps top padding and removes side and bottom spacing.
layout.insideShadowsHelp: Adds shadows to elements inside the card, including event items.
layout.cardShadowHelp: Adds a shadow around the card. Hidden automatically on phones in Preview, Wide View, and Mobile View.
layout.eventItemBordersHelp: Adds borders to event items. Useful when inside shadows are off.
layout.roundedCornersHelp: Rounds the card and media corners.
layout.showLogoHelp: Shows {cardName} branding in page footers and the mobile Preview header when the HA navbar is at the bottom.
layout.showVersionNumberHelp: Shows the installed version in page footers. General Settings always shows it.

slideshow.enableHelp: Makes Slideshow available. Start or stop it with the Slideshow button.
slideshow.alertHoldHelp: How long an alert-selected camera remains before rotation resumes.

grid.enableHelp: Adds a 2×2 grid for at least two cameras. Unavailable on mobile devices.
grid.orderHelp: Default follows Camera Settings. Custom reorders or excludes cameras only in Grid mode.
grid.noIncludedCameras: No cameras are currently included in Grid mode.
grid.liveViewHelp: Keeps all visible cameras live. Otherwise, alerts temporarily switch snapshots to live.
grid.rotationHelp: Time between camera sets when more than four cameras are included.
grid.alertHoldHelp: How long an alerted tile stays highlighted and, when needed, live.

preview.enableHelp: Adds Preview to navigation and landing-page options.
preview.liveDesktopHelp: Keeps all Preview cameras live on desktops. Otherwise, qualifying alerts and reviews switch snapshots to live.
preview.liveMobileHelp: Keeps all Preview cameras live on phones and tablets. Otherwise, qualifying alerts and reviews switch snapshots to live.
preview.showTitleBarsHelp: Shows each camera's name, source, alert count, and status.

startMode.heading: Start Mode
startMode.help: Sets the opening mode. Enable Grid or Slideshow before selecting it.
startMode.gridDisabledReason: Enable Grid Mode in Grid Mode Settings to use this option.
startMode.slideshowDisabledReason: Enable Slideshow Mode in Slideshow Settings to use this option.
startMode.gridDisabledAria: Grid. Enable Grid Mode in Grid Mode Settings to use this option.
startMode.slideshowDisabledAria: Slideshow. Enable Slideshow Mode in Slideshow Settings to use this option.

singleView.startWithAlertTakeoverHelp: Sets whether alert takeover is on when Single View opens.

wideView.enableHelp: Adds Wide View to navigation and desktop/tablet landing-page options.
wideView.liveCompanionCamerasHelp: Keeps all companion cameras live. Otherwise, qualifying alerts switch snapshots to live.
wideView.startWithAlertTakeoverHelp: Sets whether alert takeover is on when Wide View opens.
wideView.enableTimelinePanelHelp: Adds a collapsible timeline beside the event list. It follows the active camera, or all cameras in Grid mode.
wideView.openTimelineByDefaultHelp: Opens the Timeline with Wide View. Its drawer handle remains available when closed.
wideView.initialTimelineRangeHelp: Sets the initial time range. Change it later from the Timeline header.
wideView.leftColumnWidthHelp: Sets the width of Wide View's left column.
wideView.columnWidthRangeValidation: Select a whole number from {min} to {max}.

cardView.enableHelp: Adds a naturally sized live-camera page on any device. Card Height Limit does not apply.
cardView.startModeHelp: Sets the Video Only live mode. Enable Grid or Slideshow before selecting it.
cardView.standaloneHelp: Makes Card View the only {cardName} page on all devices. Removes page links and the back button.
cardView.startWithAlertTakeoverHelp: Sets whether alert takeover is on when Card View opens.
cardView.viewModeHelp: Starts with video only, or with the activity panel open or closed.
cardView.enableMediaDrawerHelp: Shows a media drawer on the left in Video Only mode.
cardView.hideCameraNameHelp: Hides the camera picker until the video is hovered or touched. Also applies in Grid mode.

mobileView.enableHelp: Adds Mobile View to navigation and landing-page options on all devices.
mobileView.rotateToFullscreenHelp: On phones, landscape rotation expands live and popup media to fullscreen. Disabled while editing or previewing the card.
mobileView.batterySaverHelp: Checks for new alerts and reviews every 60 seconds on mobile to reduce battery and data use.
mobileView.moveNavbarBottomHelp: Moves the Home Assistant dashboard navbar to the bottom on phones.
mobileView.navbarOwnerConflict: This card also claims Whole Dashboard in raw YAML, but the {cardName} at {page} {dashboard} controls it. Turn off Whole Dashboard here or remove the duplicate YAML setting.
mobileView.navbarOwnerLocked: The {cardName} at {page} {dashboard} controls Move HA Navbar to Bottom. Turn off Whole Dashboard there to change this setting.
mobileView.navbarOwnerInfo: This card controls Move HA Navbar to Bottom for the whole dashboard. {page} {dashboard}
mobileView.stackNavbarIconLabel: Stack Home Assistant Icon and Label
mobileView.stackNavbarIconLabelHelp: For tabs showing an icon and title, centers a smaller title below the icon. Other tab styles are unchanged.
mobileView.wholeDashboardHelp: Off: applies while this card is mounted on its Home Assistant page. On: applies across the dashboard, including when a popup containing this card is closed.
mobileView.dashboardBackground: Apply background to entire dashboard page
mobileView.dashboardBackgroundHelp: Uses the Mobile View background color for the surrounding Home Assistant page on mobile devices.
mobileView.headerOverlay: Display Cam Picker/Header as an overlay
mobileView.headerOverlayHelp: Places the camera header over live video. Header controls fade with the video controls; LIVE remains visible.
mobileView.outerBorderHelp: Adds the theme-colored border around Mobile View on all devices.

swipe.controlHelp: Only one {cardName} can control swipe navigation per dashboard.
swipe.ownerConflict: This card also claims swipe control in raw YAML, but the {cardName} at {page} {dashboard} controls it. Turn off this switch here or remove the duplicate YAML setting.
swipe.ownerLocked: The {cardName} at {page} {dashboard} controls Swipe Navigation. Turn it off there before enabling it here.
swipe.heading: Swipe Navigation
swipe.dashboardWideHelp: Swipe between dashboard pages and selected {cardName} pages.
swipe.insideCardOnlyHelp: Swipe between selected {cardName} pages. Other cards can be included.
swipe.landingAndDashboardHelp: Swipe between dashboard pages with the landing page as the only {cardName} stop.
swipe.noneHelp: Keep ownership but disable {cardName} swipe navigation.
swipe.includeOtherCards: Include {cardName} Cards on Other Dashboard Pages
swipe.desktopPagesHelp: Only enabled pages are shown. The PC/tablet landing page is always included.
swipe.phonePagesHelp: Wide View is unavailable on phones. The phone landing page is always included.
swipe.edgeSwipesHelp: On touch devices, edge swipes remain available for Home Assistant navigation.
swipe.mouseNavigationHelp: Enables the same navigation with a primary-button mouse drag.

landing.desktopPageHelp: Selects the starting page for desktops and tablets.
landing.phonePageHelp: Sets the phone landing flow. Preview combinations open Preview first, then the selected camera in the paired view. Required pages must be enabled.
landing.standaloneUnavailable: Unavailable while Card View is standalone because all devices start in Card View.

cameraModal.frigateIntegrationRequired: Requires the Home Assistant Frigate integration.
cameraModal.secondCameraHelp: Combines two camera entities into one view, such as main and package cameras. Only the main camera provides PTZ or two-way talk.
cameraModal.mainCameraControlsHelp: Only the main camera provides PTZ and two-way talk. Put the controllable camera first.
cameraModal.lightHelp: Adds a Home Assistant light button beside the microphone. A light can be linked to multiple cameras.
cameraModal.secondLightHelp: Places the second light independently on either side of the microphone.
cameraModal.showAllReviewsHelp: Frigate groups activity into reviews that may contain alerts, detections, or both. Enable this to show every review in the Alerts tab; disable it to show alerts only.
cameraModal.ptzHelp: Adds pan and tilt controls when supported.
cameraModal.ptzRotationHelp: Rotates directional commands to match the camera image. At 90°, Up sends Left.
cameraModal.twoWayTalkHelp: Frigate requires a WebRTC backchannel. Home Assistant is experimental and requires HA WebRTC playback.
cameraModal.checkingPtzHa: Checking Frigate PTZ support. Home Assistant remains the live connection.
cameraModal.checkingPtzFrigate: Checking Frigate PTZ support for this camera.
cameraModal.ptzUnsupported: Frigate did not report PTZ pan/tilt support for this camera.
cameraModal.checkingTalkHa: Checking Home Assistant WebRTC playback support for this camera.
cameraModal.checkingTalkFrigate: Checking Frigate two-way talk support for this camera.
cameraModal.talkUnsupportedHa: Home Assistant did not report WebRTC playback for this camera, which is required for HA-direct two-way talk.
cameraModal.talkUnsupportedFrigate: Frigate did not report two-way talk support for this camera.
cameraModal.talkExperimentalHa: Experimental: Home Assistant reports WebRTC playback, but does not report talkback capability. Enable only if this camera's Home Assistant WebRTC path accepts outgoing audio.
cameraModal.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete “{camera}”? This action cannot be undone.
cameraModal.chooseLandingPageHelp: Card View will no longer be the standalone desktop and tablet view. Select the desktop and tablet landing page to use after standalone mode is disabled.
